newsitem.title: USA: Sacramento, Calif., $225 mln school bonds defeated.
newsitem.headline: Sacramento, Calif., $225 mln school bonds defeated.

text.p: A $225 million bond measure to repair Sacramento, Calif., schools was narrowly defeated in Tuesday's election, school officials said.

With 100 percent of precincts reporting, the Sacramento City Unified School District bond measure had the support of 65.4 percent of the voters, just short of the two-thirds majority required to pass.
A similar bond measure was defeated last November.
The district had planned to use the bond money to repair its 77 schools.
